g.text: SCR02 — Clients and permissions
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-KT-02 / canonical client grants · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR02.C01 · Edit exact grants
Fields: Canonical binding/schema hash, target/user/backend, Deny/Ask/Allow and expiry
Preview exact grant diff then SCR09; CAS commit selected client rule
Failure: 403/cancel leaves old rule;409/412 opens reload/diff before new approval
SCR02.C02 · Revoke credential
Fields: Selected credential ID/kind and revision; irreversible old verifier invalidation
SCR09 approves exact credential revoke; commit epoch and close owned sessions/streams
Failure: Conflict requires fresh review; no automatic replacement token
SCR02.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR02.C04 · Add client
Fields: Selected credential kind and enrollment profile
Open SCR11 client enrollment; new clients start Deny
Failure: No proof/owner commit means no principal or grant
SCR02.C05 · Select client
Fields: Kind,12hex display fingerprint, last used and current revision
Select immutable client ID and load pinned permissions/session summary
Failure: Deleted/revoked selection shows terminal status; clear draft
SCR02.C06 · Choose exact rule
Fields: Exact rule key, policy, schema hash, constraints and expiry
Prepare rule draft only; preview transitive contract hash and argument/target bounds
Failure: Unknown schema cannot become Allow; choose narrower known rule or cancel
SCR02.C07 · Discard grant draft
Fields: Unsaved draft indicator
Discard grant draft and restore committed selected revision
Failure: No revoke or grant mutation; stay on selected client
SCR02.C08 · Inspect active sessions
Fields: Session ID/kind, connected state, epoch and expiry; no bearer
List bounded active MCP/ARC sessions owned by selected client
Failure: Stale cursor reloads session list without recreating a session
SCR02.C09 · End selected session
Fields: Exact client/session ID and observed session epoch
End selected session through fresh SCR09 review; close delivery/socket
Failure: Already closed is idempotent terminal; uncertain transport close never replays device calls
SCR02.C10 · Reload changed grants
Fields: New ETag, changed schema/grant fields
Reload current client/rule revision and show local-vs-server diff
Failure: Draft is preserved separately; never silently overwrites current rule
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR02.S0 · Selected client and exact grant revision
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Display committed rules and separate unsaved draft; session list is bounded.
Recovery: Preview a change or revoke through exact owner review; reads remain available.
SCR02.S1 · No clients: local enrollment available
Disabled: SCR02.C01, SCR02.C02, SCR02.C05, SCR02.C06, SCR02.C07, SCR02.C08, SCR02.C09, SCR02.C10
Effect: Client selectors/rule/session actions have no target.
Recovery: Add client opens SCR11; inventory and other local navigation stay available.
SCR02.S2 · Denied scope: rule unchanged
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Show which canonical binding/schema/target constraint denied; no rule broadening.
Recovery: Edit narrower known draft then fresh owner review, or cancel.
SCR02.S3 · CAS conflict: changed grant revision
Disabled: SCR02.C01, SCR02.C02, SCR02.C09
Effect: No mutation committed; old local draft and new server rule shown separately.
Recovery: Reload changed grants, compare fields, then submit a new exact approval.
SCR02.S4 · Revoked credential: sessions closed
Disabled: SCR02.C01, SCR02.C02, SCR02.C06, SCR02.C09
Effect: Verifier/epoch invalid; associated streams/input leases closed; historical rules retained.
Recovery: Enroll/rotate a new credential explicitly; old token cannot be restored.
